planning._note: endDayMaxKm caps the first and last legs because both are travel days. It applies to BOTH ends rather than one, because anticlockwise day 1 is the clockwise final leg reversed - a cap on only one end would be broken by walking the other way. 20km is the stated comfortable first-day distance and sits inside the 25km tolerance for the finish. easyDayKm/minEasyMiddleDays reserve short walking days among days 2-11 - still a full day's walk, just an easier one, not a rest day off the trail.

ascent.note: Base GPX carries no elevation; all heights are sampled from srtm30m. Validated on the closed loop: ascent and descent agree to within 12m over ~6400m of climbing.

measured.note: Distance measured directly along the 4697-point OS Maps track. The old site's x1.20 buffer was unnecessary and has been removed.
